The Consulting Club is NYU Abu Dhabi’s student-led hub for helping students build the skills, experience and connections to explore careers in consulting.

Meet the Team
About Us

Who we are

We are trying to foster a collaborative community that empowers NYUAD students to solve business problems, make strategic connections, and launch successful careers in management consulting and beyond.

Consulting, is the business of helping organizations solve problems they can't easily solve on their own. They diagnose issues, analyze data, and recommend strategies on things like operations, growth, cost-cutting, or restructuring and they typically work on a project basis, moving from client to client and industry to industry.

You should pursue consulting because it recruits from the top of the talent pool and pays like it! It is one of the fastest paths to a top-tier salary early in your career, working alongside some of the sharpest minds in business.
